(dk gas station, formally 7/11) for a vehicle versus a building crash. 2. once on scene, i observed a white gmc yukon (txlp: [identifier]) had crashed into the right front door and glass window portion of the front of the store. on the sidewalk near the entrance, i observed a female who appeared to be in pain. 3. next to this woman was the brady animal control officer (aco), jessica morrissette (txdl: 44399195, dob: [date], w/f, 5’10”, 180lbs, bro hair, haz eyes). aco morrissette told me, “she got hit.” 4. i identified the injured female as teresa savacool (txdl: 01445168, dob: [date], a/f, 5’1”, 120lbs, blk hair, bro hair). t. savacool had a jacket on her, and she explained that her right arm was in great pain. i noticed blood coming from her right sleeve, so with t. savacool’s permission, i removed her jacket. around this time, brady emergency medical services (ems) arrived, and they treated and transported t. savacool to the heart of texas (hot) hospital. 5. i identified t. savacool’s husband as karl savacool (txdl: 20124702, dob: [date], w/m, 6’4”, 225lbs, bro hair, blue eyes). k. savacool said that he was inside the gas station bathroom when this crash occurred and didn’t see what happened. i released him from [medical facility]. 6. i identified the store clerk as elsa delcambre (txdl: 13248480, dob: [date], w/f, 4’11”, 195lbs, bro hair, bro eyes). delcambre was inside the store when the crash occurred. 7. i also spoke to a witness, identifying him as aaron martinez (txid: 37582455, dob: [date], h/m, 5’10”, 210lbs, bro hair, bro eyes). martinez said the gmc appeared to slow down to park and then rapidly accelerated into the building and t. savacool. 8. the driver of the gmc was identified as synthia cory (txdl: 06586956, dob: [date], w/f, 5’7”, 138lbs, gray hair, bro eyes). cory stated that she mistook the gas pedal for the brake pedal and accelerated into the building. cory was unaware that she had struck t. savacool. 9. i observed the skid marks to be approximately two to three feet in length behind both front tires. the airbags did not deploy. 10. the metal framing around the window and the door frame sustained substantial damage. all glass from the door and window had been obliterated. the wood structures around the metal framing appeared to be intact. 11. i ran cory’s driver’s license on my in-car computer, and i discovered that her driver’s license had expired on [date]. due to her expired license and the fact that she had just struck a person and a building, i had back on your feet towing take possession of the gmc. 12. i later watched the inside security camera #2, and i watched cory crash into the building. in the video, t. savacool had her right arm in the doorway when the vehicle struck the building. 13. after removing the vehicle and cleaning the glass, i cleared the scene. 14. all video footage and pictures of this crash have been uploaded to the axon servers. 15. zachary johnson #312. 16. this crash investigation is closed. 17. nothing further.

records.public_safe_text: 1. on monday, january 1st, 2024, at approximately 11:46, i, field training officer zachary johnson with the brady police department, responded to [roadway]. (dk gas station, formally 7/11) for a vehicle versus a building crash. 2. once on scene, i observed a white gmc yukon (txlp: [identifier]) had crashed into the right front door and glass window portion of the front of the store. on the sidewalk near the entrance, i observed a female who appeared to be in pain. 3. next to this woman was the brady animal control officer (aco), jessica morrissette (txdl: 44399195, dob: [date], w/f, 5’10”, 180lbs, bro hair, haz eyes). aco morrissette told me, “she got hit.” 4. i identified the injured female as teresa savacool (txdl: 01445168, dob: [date], a/f, 5’1”, 120lbs, blk hair, bro hair). t. savacool had a jacket on her, and she explained that her right arm was in great pain. i noticed blood coming from her right sleeve, so with t. savacool’s permission, i removed her jacket. around this time, brady emergency medical services (ems) arrived, and they treated and transported t. savacool to the heart of texas (hot) hospital. 5. i identified t. savacool’s husband as karl savacool (txdl: 20124702, dob: [date], w/m, 6’4”, 225lbs, bro hair, blue eyes). k. savacool said that he was inside the gas station bathroom when this crash occurred and didn’t see what happened. i released him from [medical facility]. 6. i identified the store clerk as elsa delcambre (txdl: 13248480, dob: [date], w/f, 4’11”, 195lbs, bro hair, bro eyes). delcambre was inside the store when the crash occurred. 7. i also spoke to a witness, identifying him as aaron martinez (txid: 37582455, dob: [date], h/m, 5’10”, 210lbs, bro hair, bro eyes). martinez said the gmc appeared to slow down to park and then rapidly accelerated into the building and t. savacool. 8. the driver of the gmc was identified as synthia cory (txdl: 06586956, dob: [date], w/f, 5’7”, 138lbs, gray hair, bro eyes). cory stated that she mistook the gas pedal for the brake pedal and accelerated into the building. cory was unaware that she had struck t. savacool. 9. i observed the skid marks to be approximately two to three feet in length behind both front tires. the airbags did not deploy. 10. the metal framing around the window and the door frame sustained substantial damage. all glass from the door and window had been obliterated. the wood structures around the metal framing appeared to be intact. 11. i ran cory’s driver’s license on my in-car computer, and i discovered that her driver’s license had expired on [date]. due to her expired license and the fact that she had just struck a person and a building, i had back on your feet towing take possession of the gmc. 12. i later watched the inside security camera #2, and i watched cory crash into the building. in the video, t. savacool had her right arm in the doorway when the vehicle struck the building. 13. after removing the vehicle and cleaning the glass, i cleared the scene. 14. all video footage and pictures of this crash have been uploaded to the axon servers. 15. zachary johnson #312. 16. this crash investigation is closed. 17. nothing further.

[school facility] zone as well as signs attached to the lights that state between 7:15am and 8:00am cell phone use is prohibited with a fine up to $200. after review of rhe camera footage, a black infinity suv with the tx license plate #[identifier] turned into officer dove, striking his left knee and hip and spinning him around. officer dove used his left hand to defend from the impact and push himself away. officer dove appeared disoriented after the impact and it took him a few moments to get back into position to direct traffic. the incident happened on [date] at 7:42am. the black infinity turned into officer dove striking him, overcorrected and then stopped completely after impact. this was evident by the brakes like lights coming on and the infinity coming to a complete stop. the infinity then drove off [roadway], failing to stop after striking officer dove and failing to render aid. officer dove is clearly seen in the video wearing a police uniform with a yellow reflective traffic vest on that says police on the front and back. officer doves marked police vehicle was behind him [roadway] with all emergency lights activated. another parent (ana leon, amleon2007@gmail. com) was behind the infinity and witnessed the incident. leon emailed rhe principal vanessa randalls with the license plate (tx [identifier]). the license plate is registered to a matthew and courtney kelly. the same infinity is seen in the drop off line drop off rhe students jack and brock kelly that were identified by staff members emily bolles and kim fromberg. emily bolles also identified the driver as courtney kelly. mcgees married name is kelly and the name showing on her texas drivers license is her maiden name mcgee. kim fromberg on [date] [school facility] today and he stated his mother (courtney mcgee). officer dove was also able to identify courtney mcgee as the driver that struck him by her picture. by failing to stop after striking and injuring officer dove with her vehicle courtney mcgee committed the offense duty to give information and render aid (tx traffic code 550. 023, 3rd degree felony). after the incident on [date] officer dove stated that his left thumb, left hip, and left knee had pain, officer dove stated that his left knee had noticeable swelling and he had a noticeable bruise on his left hip. a doctor visit on [date] after the incident gave the diagnoses of:sprain of the left knee (must wear hinged knee brace while at work)contusion of left hip and thighcontusion of left knee
